items.title: ML Zoomcamp 2026 Pre-Course Live Q&A
items.author: DataTalksClub ⬛
items.summary:
In this pre-course Q&A session, Alexey Grigorev, Founder of DataTalks.Club, shares essential guidance on navigating the Machine Learning Zoomcamp and building a career in modern ML and AI engineering. We explore the foundations of classical machine learning, model deployment strategies, and how to position yourself in an evolving tech landscape.

Links:
- Q&A: https://qna.dtcdev.click/r/ml-zoomcamp
- Course: https://github.com/DataTalksClub/machine-learning-zoomcamp
- Sign up: https://courses.datatalks.club/register/ml-zoomcamp/
- https://github.com/alexeygrigorev/ai-engineering-field-guide/blob/main/role/02-skills.md
- https://aishippingblog.com/p/what-ai-forward-deployed-engineers
- https://aishippingblog.com/p/getting-an-ai-engineering-job
- https://aishippingblog.com/p/benefits-of-learning-in-public-and
- https://github.com/alexeygrigorev/ai-engineering-field-guide/blob/main/webinars/01-a-day-of-ai-engineer.md
- https://datatalks.club/blog/data-roles.html

You’ll learn about:
- What to expect from hands-on modules covering regression, tree models, deep learning, and deployment with Fast API, AWS Lambda, and Kubernetes.
- Why classical machine learning remains essential, cost-effective, and foundational even in the age of LLMs.
- The minimal Python, math, Docker, and GitHub skills required to succeed in the course.
- Understanding the key differences between Machine Learning Engineers, AI Engineers, and Data Engineers to find your ideal career path.
- How to effectively manage time budgets, avoid theory rabbit holes, and build a standout portfolio by learning in public.
- Grading criteria, project deadlines, and policies on using AI tools effectively during the course.
